receipt.public_excerpt: Trained on our Colossus supercluster with 10x the compute of previous state-of-the-art models

evidence_items.explanation: xAI names one cluster, Colossus, and gives 10x compute, not 15x. That cuts against 'two new data centers' and the 15x figure. Note the 10x is measured against prior state-of-the-art models, not explicitly against Grok 2.

receipt.public_excerpt: In 122 days, xAI transformed an abandoned Electrolux factory in Memphis into “Colossus,” with 100,000 Nvidia H100 GPUs, then doubled it to 200,000 in another 92 days

evidence_items.explanation: Grok 3 was trained in one repurposed Memphis facility that was expanded in two phases, not in two new data centers. It does confirm a very large build-out over many months.

evidence_items.locator: section on Colossus and training, paragraph after the training-details quote

receipt.public_excerpt: They trained Grok 3 for 200 million GPU-hours for training, about 15 times more compute than used to train Grok 2.

evidence_items.explanation: A summary of the launch event gives about 15x Grok 2's compute and 200 million GPU-hours. That fits '15x' and a months-long run. It is a secondary source.
